content.text: And it shall come to pass
I will not add any more to
that I should altogether pardon them
and it shall come to pass,
me: and I will make them
to them, and she decked herself
and will make them to lie down
And it shall come to pass
that thou shalt be no priest
to me: seeing thou hast forgotten
lift up their soul to their iniquity
and they have gone a whoring
to the king that should plead
and he will bind us up.
their silver shall be desired, the nettle etc
unto him: and they shall be
a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth
unto himself: according to the multitude
to them as they that take off
have I to do any more
